entities.name: Selvala
entities.description: A skilled tracker and killer imprisoned in Grenzo's dungeon in Paliano, who has survived in the wild and killed a friend, Brago.

entities.name: Grenzo
entities.description: A hunched goblin dungeon keeper who commands a network of spies and killers beneath Paliano and knows its secret passages.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: An inventor, student of Daretti, who plans to replace the living with perfectly crafted automata; he sleeps behind a door in his library.

entities.name: Daretti
entities.description: The teacher of Muzzio, who the story says looked down at his legs one morning and said he could do better.

entities.name: Brago
entities.description: Selvala's friend, whom she stabbed; Grenzo says he had secret plots, and his bedchamber lies in the palace.

entities.name: Sydri
entities.description: The owner of a shop in Paliano above Grenzo's tunnels.

entities.name: Paliano
entities.description: A city divided into a low city and a high city, with sewers and secret tunnels beneath it.

entities.name: Fiora
entities.description: The realm whose secret heart Grenzo says lies beneath Paliano; it has a king.

entities.name: Muzzio's Library
entities.description: A secret library reached through a hidden door, filled with clockwork automata and a towering guardian machine.

entities.name: Muzzio's Guardian
entities.description: A two-story wooden and iron machine that guards Muzzio's sleeping chamber and attacks Selvala.

entities.name: Grenzo's agents
entities.description: Mercenary killers and spies who swarm the sewers of Paliano for the dungeon keeper.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Goblins of Paliano's tunnels who serve Grenzo and fear him.

events.summary: Selvala sits in isolation in a dungeon cell among insects, hearing the dungeon keeper taunt her; she had earlier dealt with goblins who came to her door.
events.quote: She'd dealt with each of them in turn.

events.summary: Grenzo asks what it is like to kill a man you love, and Selvala answers that it is all too easy; he unlocks the cell door.
Grenzo leads Selvala through the tunnels under Paliano, pointing out the palace, Brago's bedchamber, Sydri's shop and the treasury.
events.quote: Slowly, the map of Paliano began to make sense to her

events.summary: Grenzo offers Selvala gold, access, information or the chance to kill an enemy.
events.quote: "What about the opportunity to kill an enemy for a change?"

events.summary: Grenzo opens a secret door and Selvala enters Muzzio's library full of clockwork automata.
events.quote: All around Selvala, ornate automata clanked and whirred.

events.summary: Grenzo describes Muzzio, student of Daretti, who promises a perfectly crafted, programmed world to replace the living.
events.quote: He promised us a new world.

events.summary: Grenzo asks Selvala to kill the sleeping Muzzio, saying a king with no blood and beasts of iron flesh are the future unless she acts.
events.quote: Through that door, Muzzio lies sleeping.

events.summary: Selvala refuses, kicks away Grenzo's staff and threatens his throat.
events.quote: I will not be your hired thug.

events.summary: Muzzio's guardian machine wakes and attacks Selvala, who dodges it.
events.quote: She turned her head to watch the great construct rise from its spiritless slumber.

events.summary: Grenzo escapes down the secret stairs and locks the trap door; Selvala breaks the lock with her bone and flees.
events.quote: Then, with a snap, the bone cracked in half and the lock gave way.

events.summary: Selvala flees through the sewers with Muzzio's tomes while automata chase her, and Grenzo's killers and Muzzio's artificial animals are about to clash.
events.quote: Soon they would clash—Grenzo's secret killers and Muzzio's artificial animals

events.summary: Selvala hides in an unlocked cell and plans to leave the High City for the wild the next day.
events.quote: She found an unlocked cell and crawled into the corner with the beetles.

relations.quote: Then maybe you wouldn't have been so quick to stab.

relations.note: She refuses to serve him and threatens him.
relations.quote: I will not be your hired thug.

relations.note: His agents work for the dungeon keeper.
relations.quote: about his agents swarming in the sewers

relations.note: Reached through the tunnels beneath Paliano.
relations.quote: Slowly, the map of Paliano began to make sense to her

rejected.summary: Selvala tells Grenzo she is armed with a sharpened femur; he reveals she took the eye of one of his best agents with it.
